note: CI-5 (CB.23 follow-ups): (a) cmd/ assigns a group to a field of ANOTHER package's struct (`s := &api.Server{}; s.Public = r.Group("/public")`); the field mount names its owner through the import (`api::Server`), so the routes api registers on s.Public get /public. (b) admin.NewPanel stores `rg.Group("/admin")` on a field of a parameter-handed group and registers on it in the same file: the field holds rg's mount, not the root. Baseline HEAD f8a46c0: GET /items (owner keyed cmd::Server, never mounted) and GET /admin/stats (CB.11's in-file `known` roots rg).
